```html
<button type='button' id='open-modal'>Open</button>
```

For a real submit handler, call `event.preventDefault()` there instead.

async map gives promises in output const rows=data.map(async x=>await makeRow(x))

`map` does not await its callback. Await all row promises together.

```js
const rows = await Promise.all(data.map(x => makeRow(x)));
```

This preserves input order while allowing the work to run concurrently.
